name: CData Connect AI
description: Queries and updates data in hundreds of SaaS apps and databases with SQL through one hosted MCP server, for agents in Claude, Copilot Studio, n8n and other MCP clients.

skills.name: Dataset Search
skills.description: Searches datasets and fields that match a natural-language question, returning fully qualified names, field descriptions and join hints.

skills.name: Metadata Browsing
skills.description: Lists connections, schemas, tables and columns with getCatalogs, getSchemas, getTables and getColumns to map a data source before querying it.

skills.name: SQL Queries
skills.description: Runs SELECT queries against connected data sources with queryData and returns CSV results, using fully qualified [Catalog].[Schema].[Table] names.

skills.name: Row Inserts and Updates
skills.description: Inserts and updates rows in a connected table with execute_insert and execute_update; the ops URL parameter can hide both for read-only use.

skills.name: Stored Procedures
skills.description: Lists stored procedures and their parameters, then executes them for a chosen catalog and schema with getProcedures and executeProcedure.
